blocks.text: Introduction: This is the first fundamental doctrine of Christ in the scripture. Nobody can lay claim to being born again without the step of genuine repentance.

It is a firm conscious personal decision to change from sin (obedience to the devil) to righteousness in obedience towards God, living holy, it is not an emotion. {{hb 6:1,hb 6:2|Heb. 6:1-2}} {{act 3:19|Acts 3:19}}; 1Thes. 1:5-10

cards.heading: 2. Repentance must involve the steps of - Part 1 of 2

items: Acknowledge the fact that you have sinned. {{rm 3:23|Rom 3:23}}
Confess your sins. {{1jo 1:9|I John 1:9}}
Ask God for forgiveness and His mercy. {{is 55:7|Isa. 55:7}},
Ask for Divine ability to forsake your sins. {{prv 28:13|Prov. 28:13}};

blocks.text: 3. How important is the subject to us as believers? Genuine repentance is followed by desirable fruits of love, peace, patience faith etc. {{lk 3:7,lk 3:8,lk 3:9|Luke 3: 7-9}} - Jesus our Lord and master commanded us to repent and be saved. {{mk 6:12|Mark 6: 12}}, {{lk 24:46,lk 24:47|Luke 24: 46-47}} - Peter commended it {{act 2:37,act 2:38|Acts 2: 37-38}} Paul commended it {{act 17:30,act 17:31|Acts 17: 30-31}} Nobody can say he is born again without genuine repentance.

items: What are the dead works from which we have to repent?
The works of the flesh Phil3: 1-3, Gal.5:19-21
Idols IThesl:9
Empty religion and all unrighteousness II Tim3:1-9, {{1co 6:9,1co 6:10,1co 6:11|I Cor. 6:9-11}}
Elements of genuine repentance
Conviction - before any sinner can repent, he must be convicted that he has urgent need to make his way right With God. Ps 3 8: 4; 51: 3; {{act 2:3|Acts 2: 3}} 7
Godly sorrow: This comes as a consequence of conviction by the Holy Spirit leading to repentance.IICor7:10
Renunciation: True repentance involves grief and hatred for sin turning from it to God. Is 55:7

cards.heading: 2. Repentance must involve the steps of - Part 2 of 2

blocks.text: 6. Distinguish between genuine repentance and remorse

GENUINE REPENTANCE Leads to salvation REMORSE Comes from the Spirit Leads to death Godly sorrow for sin Comes from emotion Regret for wrong doing Heartfelt confession and desire to forsake sin Shallow and transient concern about sin Physical manifestation of holy life, thoughts and work Turbulent life of sorrow and failure

items: What are the results of genuine repentance; {{ps 51:12,ps 51:13,ps 51:14|Ps 51: 12-14}}.
Cleansing with the blood of Jesus by faith. {{1jo 1:7,1jo 1:8,1jo 1:9|I John 1: 7-9}}
Assurance of forgiveness. {{rm 5:1|Rom 5: 1}}
No more condemnation thus ability to have fruitful fellowship with God in prayer. {{rm 8:1|Rm 8:1}}
Justification as if sins never occurred. A new creation. {{2co 5:17|II Cor 5: 17}}
Peace with God and man. Is 30: 15
Burden of sin is lifted resulting in a time of refreshing. {{act 3:19|Acts 3: 19}}
Joy of salvation. {{ps 51:12,ps 51:13,ps 51:14|Ps 51: 12-14}}

conclusion.text: Remember, God is not mocked {{ps 86:5|Psalm 86:5}}. The wages of sin is death but, God is ready to forgive if there is a genuine repentance.
